title: one tetrahedron covers half the units — a machine-checked theorem of the ℤ/9 vortex deposit
description:
one tetrahedron covers half the units, declared in src/proof/merkaba.lean and accepted by the Lean 4 kernel, sorry-free and axiom-free, closing by by decide.

Statement (Lean):

(units.filter (fun d => tetA.contains d)).length = 3 ∧ (units.filter (fun d => tetB.contains d)).length = 3 ∧ units.length = 6

Statement (LaTeX):

\left|\{\, d \in \mathrm{units} \mid d \in \mathrm{tetA} \,\}\right| = 3 \land \left|\{\, d \in \mathrm{units} \mid d \in \mathrm{tetB} \,\}\right| = 3 \land \left|\mathrm{units}\right| = 6

What this record establishes. A dated, public, citable deposit of this declaration and its proof, recomputable from the source it names. That is priority. It is not a claim that the result is unknown to the literature: prior art for this file is recorded in src/proof/priorart.lean as unclassified — no prior-art search has been performed, so no novelty is asserted.

Scope. The declaration is decided over a finite domain by exhaustion. It settles no Clay Millennium Problem and claims no quantum speedup. 0/7.
